## Hiking Club coordination packet — Denver weekend hike

### Verified details
- **Meeting time:** 8:00 AM sharp
- **Meeting location:** The trailhead (specific trailhead not identified)
- **Supplies:** Sarah Chen offered to bring trail mix and a first-aid kit.
- **Parking:** David was asked to handle the parking pass; completion is not verified.

### Not found / needs confirmation
- Hike date and Denver-area trail name
- Trailhead address or directions
- Booking references or confirmation codes
- Transportation and lodging details
- Permit or reservation information
- Final attendee list and emergency contacts
- Final snack assignments beyond Sarah’s proposed trail mix
- Confirmation that the parking pass has been obtained

The available calendar, email, notes, and task records do not contain verified Denver-specific bookings or travel details. An unrelated Alaska Airlines reservation was excluded from this packet.

### Draft reply to the Hiking Club
> Hi everyone — I’m checking the trail logistics for this weekend’s Denver hike, including the exact trailhead, directions, and parking arrangements. Sarah’s trail mix and first-aid kit are noted, and I’ll finalize the remaining snack assignments once the logistics are confirmed. We currently have an 8:00 AM trailhead meeting noted, but please send or confirm the trail name, exact meeting point, and parking-pass status so I can circulate the complete plan.
>
> Thanks!
